001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.general;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
006import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
007import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
008import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
010import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import java.util.UUID;
013
014/**
015 * Calling when purchaser prepared to purchase a shop (click the shop)
016 */
017public class ShopInfoPanelEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
018
019  @NotNull
020  private final Shop shop;
021
022  @NotNull
023  private final UUID purchaser;
024  @Nullable
025  private final Player player;
026
027  private boolean cancelled;
028  private Component cancelReason;
029
030  /**
031   * Builds a new shop info panel event
032   *
033   * @param shop      The shop bought from
034   * @param purchaser The player purchasing, may offline if purchase by plugin
035   */
036  public ShopInfoPanelEvent(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final UUID purchaser) {
037
038    this.shop = shop;
039    this.purchaser = purchaser;
040    this.player = Bukkit.getPlayer(purchaser);
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Gets the purchaser
045   *
046   * @return Player or null if purchaser is offline/virtual player.
047   */
048  public @Nullable Player getPlayer() {
049
050    return this.player;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Gets the purchaser, that maybe is an online/offline/virtual player.
055   *
056   * @return The purchaser uuid
057   */
058  public @NotNull UUID getPurchaser() {
059
060    return this.purchaser;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Gets the shop
065   *
066   * @return the shop
067   */
068  public @NotNull Shop getShop() {
069
070    return this.shop;
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
075
076    return this.cancelReason;
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
081
082    this.cancelled = cancel;
083    this.cancelReason = reason;
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public boolean isCancelled() {
088
089    return cancelled;
090  }
091}
